keyLearnings.learning: update() vs merge() semantic difference is critical
keyLearnings.detail: SurrealDB's update() replaces ALL fields, merge() does partial updates. Using update() without all fields causes NONE values. This was the root cause bug.

The custom HTTP RPC client was created to work around auth bugs in surrealdb-py v1.0.8 with SurrealDB v2.3.10. But the custom implementation introduced NEW bugs (parameter serialization). Upgrading both to compatible versions (surrealdb-py >=1.0.0 + SurrealDB v3.0+) is the proper fix.
Making one database function async requires making ALL callers async, which ripples through the entire codebase. This is why Phase 2 is taking longer than estimated.
keyLearnings.recommendation: Future database clients should be async from the start
